"Connor... A battalion of Redcoats is marching on the north road toward Boston. The officer leading them possesses sensitive information concerning the Sons of Liberty. He must not be allowed to reach the British garrison in Charlestown." - S.A.

From the Journal of Ari Sawi, proud Mohawk, 1758: There's a change coming with the autumn wind. The English have begun to encroach on our land. We can keep them at bay for now, but this is only the beginning. I fear for my son Connor, for what sort of world he'll grow up in...

"Some men are going to toss a shipment of British tea into the harbour, but an officer named Johnson has a lead on their identities. If he survives, there will surely be a massacre. Meet my contact in Boston. He'll give you Johnson's location." - S.A.

"A British General named Pitcairn has holed up in Boston with his men. The Sons of Liberty are prepared to storm the city, but we need to ensure that the British don't receive naval reinforcements. I need you to lead an assault on their fleet. Don't let us down." - S.A.

"Our worst fears are coming true: all-out war with England! The full might of the Crown will soon be upon us, and we're going to need all the help we can get. General Washington is gathering his men at Bunker Hill. Go see if you can lend a hand." - S.A.

"New York is burning, set ablaze by the Redcoats in their mad pursuit of General Washington. Their assassin, Hickey, is closing in fast, and worse, they've taken several members of the Continental Congress hostage! If our revolution is to survive, we need your help." - S.A.

"The Redcoats have New York City surrounded. Our forces there have suffered heavy casualties. We have reinforcements coming by sea, but to reach us they'll have to get past the British Navy! Protect them, Connor. Everything depends on it." - S.A.

"Horrible news: Haytham, a man we thought we could trust, is actually an agent of the Crown! He's currently holed up in Fort George. I have men posing as British soldiers, but they won't be able to get close enough to him unless they have something he wants - you." -S.A.

"The war is over. Even now I hardly believe it, but the British are indeed retreating. There's only one loose end left: Charles Lee. Our scouts have tracked him to Boston, where he is gathering the last of his men to flee by sea. He is yours to deal with as you see fit." - S.A.

One of the largest cities in the entire country, and also one of the most volatile. The gathering place of the Sons of Liberty, New York is the front line in the revolt against the Crown.
